act_title: The Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934
title: Obligations of Government and the Bank in respect of rupee coin
text:
38. Obligations of Government and the Bank in respect of rupee coin.—The [Central

Government] shall undertake not to put into circulation any rupees, except through the Bank, 
and the Bank shall undertake not to dispose of rupee coin otherwise than for the purposes of
circulation .
